# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release of SMRITI Retail OS is actively supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| v2.1.x  | :white_check_mark: |
| < v2.1  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of SMRITI Retail OS seriously. If you find any vulnerability, please report it privately.

**Please do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Email your report to: **security@erpnbook.com**

Include in your report:
- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Detailed steps to reproduce the issue (and proof-of-concept code/screenshots if available).
- Your contact details.

We will acknowledge receipt of your report within 48 hours and work with you to remediate the vulnerability.
